name: How long does a whole-home remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole-home remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-home remodel varies significantly based on the project's complexity and scope. Smaller remodels might take 3-6 months, while extensive projects involving structural changes or custom designs could extend to 8-12 months or longer. Factors like permitting processes in Las Vegas, material lead times, and unforeseen discoveries can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront to set clear expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole-home remodels typically take 3-12 months, depending on scope and complexity. Factors like permitting and material lead times affect the schedule.
